entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Yeah, hi, I need to make a return. Now.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with a return. May I have your name and the order number, please?
Sure, it's under John Smith, order 774-B-91. It's for the VeloBand Pulse.
Thank you, John. I have your order right here. To process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. Frankly, the thing is garbage.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into some troubleshooting steps or connect you with our technical support team to verify the defect—
No. Look, I don't have time for that. It doesn't work. I just want my money back. I need a refund.
I understand completely. You just want a quick resolution. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now. I see the item was delivered 34 days ago.
Okay... and? Is that a yes or a no?
It's a yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I've just approved the return for you.
Oh. Okay, good. So you're sending a label?

Yes, I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just pack the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the full refund processed as soon as our warehouse receives it.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, John?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
